digest.component_or_area: rich-text sync codec and baseline state
propositions: State-based echo suppression via persisted rich_sha digest and reemit counter prevents lossy codec convergence loops; a matching wire seen twice triggers one GET overlay into baseline, then resets counter on any wire change.

Two distinct normalizations route through different compare paths: emit compares normalized remote against non-normalized local; baseline compares normalized local against decoded baseline wire, preventing false local-changed signals.

DC create paths (_map_local_to_dc_fields and _translate_create_fields) must both render markdown to wiki via to_wire∘fit_outbound composition; update path uses the same codec to avoid new-issue formatted-text divergence.
WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefined as decode_inbound∘to_wire restores codec law for DC without shifting comment-diff dedup key, which uses only identity codec via _resolve_codec.
Cutover flag (reconciler.rich_text_cutover: off|cloud|dc|both) gates all send paths; with flag off or import failure, plain-wire path is byte-identical to pre-cutover behavior.
